text.text_excerpt: By far my favorite bar in the Quarter, this is the quintessential neighborhood bar full of locals. The bartenders are extremely nice and fun. One in particular does an awesome bloody mary, just don't ask for one if it is crowded. She refuses to half ass it. Right around the corner is Cabrini Dog Park. Cosimo's is the closest bar, so we love picking up a cocktail and enjoying it at the park while our dogs run around (I love New Orleans).

Seems like a really cool spot as I noticed its on of those places that can be like a Cheers type of joint. Everyone seemed to know each other so I'm sure its a place where the locals go to stay away from ridiculous tourists like myself...lol Bartenders and staff were really nice as they offered me some complimentary pizza which came in handy because I was drunk and hungry. This place is located almost on the edge of the Quarter. Nice R&B music was playing so I was definitely enjoying the music vibe here. Cool spot to hit up if you wanna get away from all the tourists in the Quarter.

After hearing all kinds of raves about Cosimo's, I figured it was time to check it out. This is a nice little neighborhood bar that is far away from the hustle and bustle of the quarter. It's a friendly place where everyone seems to know everyone. We didn't stay a really long time, but I was able to try a bloody Mary and it was just as good as Joi had described. I like that it's a little darker here. I have an appreciation for darker, cozier bars.
